name: Fixture and Finish
description:
Fixture and Finish is a selections and procurement platform built for custom home builders, interior designers, and design-build firms. This connector brings your project data into Claude, so you can ask questions in plain language from anywhere — the office, the job site, or your phone.

Ask Claude to:

- Look up any item on a project — fixture specs, finishes, model numbers, dimensions, and installation details
- Check procurement status across projects: what's been ordered, what's shipped, what needs a decision
- Search your selection library of products you've already vetted and used
Import a product from any vendor page into your library and attach it to an item
- Create follow-up tasks and reminders on a project

Instead of digging through emails, spreadsheets, and spec sheets, ask: "What's the fan in the Leesburg primary bedroom, and how does the remote work?" or "What's still unordered for the kitchen at Wilson Lane?" and get an answer grounded in your actual project data.

Fixture and Finish keeps selections, specs, vendors, and purchase status structured in one place, so client-facing docs, field schedules, and answers like these work out of the box. Requires a Fixture and Finish account; trials are free with no credit card required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Fixture and Finish to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fixture and Finish to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://fixtureandfinish.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fixture and Finish MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fixture and Finish provides these MCP tools: add_selection_to_item, create_task, find_items, get_item_context, get_procurement_summary, import_selection_candidate, list_projects, and search_selections.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Fixture and Finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Fixture and Finish in creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Clipkit, Backstage, Interior Company, vivideo-prompt-builder, and gpt-war.

_published_faq.name: Does Fixture and Finish MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fixture and Finish requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Fixture and Finish is developed by Fixture and Finish, LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
